address: 广东省广州市荔湾区昌华街道陈廉伯公馆逢源大街历史文化街区
opening_hours: 周二至周日 09:00-17:30 17:00停止入馆，周一闭馆，春节期间正常开馆
intro: 荔湾博物馆位于广州市荔湾区，毗邻荔湾湖公园，以西关民俗文化为主题，通过实物与场景展示老广州西关一带的风土人情与传统建筑风貌。
intro_en: The Liwan Museum is located in Liwan District, Guangzhou, adjacent to Liwan Lake Park. With Xiguan folk culture as its theme, it showcases the local customs and traditional architectural features of the old Xiguan area of Guangzhou through real objects and scene displays.
opening_hours_en:
Location: Liwan Museum
Open Tuesday to Sunday, 09:00-17:30 (last admission at 17:00); closed on Mondays. Open as usual during the Spring Festival.

address: 广东省广州市天河区石牌街道天寿路2-12号
intro: 广州体育文化博物馆是位于广州的体育主题博物馆，通过实物、图片等展品展示广州体育发展历程与体育文化，是了解这座城市体育历史的窗口。
intro_en: The Guangzhou Sports Culture Museum is a sports-themed museum located in Guangzhou. Through exhibits such as artifacts and photographs, it showcases the development of sports in Guangzhou and its sports culture, serving as a window into the city's sports history.
address_en: No. 2-12 Tianshou Road, Shipai Subdistrict, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong

address: 重庆市沙坪坝区陈家桥街道大学城北路西永九号
intro: 巴蜀古代建筑博物馆位于重庆市，是一座以巴蜀地区传统古代建筑为主题的博物馆，收藏、展示古建筑构件与相关文物，展现巴蜀建筑的历史风貌与营造技艺。
intro_en: The Bashu Ancient Architecture Museum, located in Chongqing, is a museum themed on traditional ancient architecture of the Bashu region. It collects and displays ancient architectural components and related cultural relics, showcasing the historical character and construction techniques of Bashu architecture.
address_en: No.9 Yong West, North Daxuecheng Road, Chenjiaqiao Subdistrict, Shapingba District, Chongqing

address: 上海市闵行区七宝镇漕宝立体停车场
intro: 闵行博物馆是位于上海市闵行区的综合性博物馆，展示闵行地区的历史沿革与民俗文化，常设展览呈现上海县的历史变迁，是了解当地人文的窗口。
name_aliases: ["闵行区博物馆", "上海闵行博物馆"]
